## What changed from the original calendar

The first version of this page ran fifteen consecutive Thursdays, 9/3 to 12/10. Two things moved it:

- **Chuseok.** 9/24 falls in the 추석 연휴, so there is no class that week. Rather than lose a session, every session from the old Week 4 onward runs **one week later**, and the final defense moves into Week 16 (12/17), the university's official make-up week. If you saw "Week 4 — Theoretical point of departure" on an earlier version, that session is now **Week 5 on 10/1**.
- **Conference Thursdays.** In four weeks the Thursday slot is unavailable, so the session meets on the **Tuesday of the same week** instead: 10/20, 11/3, 11/10 and 11/24. Nothing else about those sessions changes — same format, same roles.

For Tuesday sessions, anything due "before class" is counted back from the Tuesday. Time and room for the Tuesday sessions are announced on ETL.

No other session date in this span coincides with a 2026 Korean public holiday (Gaecheonjeol falls on Saturday 10/3, its substitute holiday on Monday 10/5; Hangeul Day falls on Friday 10/9).
